gen-gf-phudu-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std is a plain sans with connected counters and a restrained swell in its curves, quietly understated. Phudu draws a marker-like line with a loud voice; the body murmurs underneath.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-cairo-play: Loud and marker-drawn up top: Phudu keeps one fixed line weight, while Cairo Play brings open round letters that stay clear small. Paragraphs below it move along smoothly, with a modern, polished tone.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-cambay: Thick marker strokes, every one carrying the same visual weight, make Phudu hard to miss. Cambay sits next to it with modern, gapped rounds, like a cracked bangle, and feels lighter.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-doto: Chunky and marker-drawn, Phudu holds a constant line, while Doto gives every glyph wide margins of space around it. Next to each other, one shouts and the other breathes.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-el-messiri: Phudu draws every stroke with one fixed nib, bold and unmistakable at the top of a page. And El Messiri adds a middling thick-thin shift and a wide slot in the c below.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-electrolize: Blunt, bold, and gleefully marker-drawn, Phudu ignores the direction of its strokes. Electrolize, a sans-serif with an open-jawed c like pliers, feels modern and tidy beside that loud, wobble-free line.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-encode-sans: Phudu is a loud display face with no shift in weight along any curve, and generous openings at each terminal. Encode Sans stays quiet beside it, its gaps keeping c distinct from o.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-encode-sans-sc: Phudu has no calligraphic thinning anywhere, just bold, plain strokes. It is built to grab the eye, while Encode Sans SC, a sans-serif with shallow terminal curls and a wide gap, is built to be read.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang is a plain sans, its rounds carrying a faint nib-pressure shift and finishing well before they close. Phudu, meanwhile, lays down a stripe of constant ink, loud and bold.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-figtree: Loud, ballpoint-plain, and open at every curve, Phudu takes the lead. Figtree, a sans drawn as if with a marker tip, echoes that and keeps an e with a wide gap at its terminal.
